# #225 / F182 after-proof: CPU 19.41%, down from about 33%

Deployed commit `fa5e3d3c315caf3edd2124f1f1368ca4328e1fb8`, PID **20308**, start **10 Nov 17:51:30 UTC+10**. The first-minute gate passed at age 172.74 seconds. One 300-second window ran **17:54:22.832024 to 17:59:22.839369 UTC+10**, duration **300.006691 s**. Bracketing healthy pings agree on PID/build, process-start identity is unchanged, and all launch-site sums reconcile. The bounce hold is released.

| Metric | Saved PID 45657 baseline / hour | After F182, PID 20308 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Daemon CPU, interval percent of one CPU | 32.6328% / 32.9731% | **19.4062%** |
| CPU seconds per approximately 300 s | 97.90 / 98.92 | **58.22** |
| Daemon launches | 188 / 173 | **35**, 0.11666/s |
| RSS within this window, MiB | Separate process/age | **193.0000 -> 194.6094** |

This is **13.23 to 13.57 percentage points lower** than the paired 45657 observations, or about **41% below the rounded 33% reference**. CPU time is 0:48.24 -> 1:46.46, not the lifetime `ps %cpu`. RSS rose 1,648 KiB (1.6094 MiB); cross-process RSS differences are not evidence of a leak fix.

## Exactly one authorized stack sample

`/usr/bin/sample 20308 10` sampled at 1 ms from **17:54:42.778**, inside the window; command receipt 17:54:42 -> 17:54:53. Launch time in the profile agrees with the daemon. Main-thread observations: **5,565**. Raw stacks remain local; no retry or additional sample.

**Tap path has positive live coverage:** `PaneObserver::start -> drain_pane_tap -> File::read_to_end -> read` appears with six leaf observations. Tap metadata/stat paths also appear (25 `stat` observations and one metadata frame). **No tap-descended open frame was sampled.** This is not an empty or wholly inactive tap sample. The instrument still observes opens: the raw tree has two `__open` observations and one `__open_nocancel`, under `directory::memory -> community::root::find`, not tap drains. The collapsed table only prints counts >=5, so its missing `__open` entry must not be read as zero.

The old all-thread collapsed `__open` counts were 766 / 153, with large tap-drain branches. The new read-without-a-sampled-tap-open shape supports the held-fd mechanism already checked in source and CI; it does not prove that no initial, replacement or trim open can occur.

**Registry work remains:** `whoami_resolved -> identity::resolve_seat -> SqliteRegistry::list` is still observed twice, while registry row decoding/drops also appear under `PaneObserver::start` and `start_resilient_binders`. Collapsed SQLite leaf observations are:

| Leaf | Old baseline / hour | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| `sqlite3BtreeTableMoveto` | 123 / 57 | 41 |
| `sqlite3VdbeExec` | 104 / 56 | 37 |
| `sqlite3Malloc` | 62 / 37 | 13 |
| `sqlite3_value_free` | 50 / 20 | 7 |
| `sqlite3_value_dup` | 39 / 22 | 7 |

These are **all-thread wall-stack observations, not CPU percentages, query counts or decoded-row counts**. Waits dominate: `__psynch_cvwait` 87,935; semaphore wait 21,421; recv 11,130; kevent 5,459. Different observation totals/phases prevent interpreting leaf-count ratios as measured CPU savings.

No `register_inner` frame was observed. In fact the full five-minute registration tally contains only **60 holder-current refusals, zero ps**, with viper, stoat and worthwhile-sole each 20/0; there were **no completed explicit/admitted registrations**. Thus this capture does **not demonstrate live coverage** of the later Copilot-only handoff snapshot or measure its live row count. That part retains source/CI proof, not an invented live observation. F162's zero-ps result remains intact. P225-N001's early-guard, locked-registration and observer full-roster costs remain.

## Launch receipts

Ping launch counter **330 -> 365** over the same 300.006691 seconds. Sites: `git.community` **25**, `ddocs.community` **8**, `sh.background-job` **1**, `tmux.pipe-pane detach` **1**; all other sites flat, including native-process ps.

Requested `just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json`: **17:54:42 -> 17:55:02**, daemon PID 20308, **99.4 launches/s endpoint-PID estimate**, **94.9/s observed lower bound**, 191,645 polls. Lower-bound attribution: 58.3/s gone before inspection, 36.5/s other. No daemon-child bucket was observed in that short slice; the full-window ping counter, not this absence, accounts for daemon launches.

## Interpretation and closure

The live observation supports a substantial CPU improvement and the expected tap-read shape. It does **not** isolate the whole 41% change to F182: this is a younger process, host load/workload was quieter, prior machine samplers ran 300 seconds whereas this explicitly requested one ran 20 seconds, and accepted-registration traffic differed. The later post-F162 PID 3744 receipt was still 31.7325% with zero lease ps, but also had 16 explicit registrations, unlike this window. No all-CPU attribution or claim that all full-registry work disappeared.

The requested deployed capture and two-path inspection are complete, closing the after-reading deliverable on verdict `55e6e4e2` subject to the explicit admitted-registration coverage limit above. CPU is improved, not zero. No private daemon, build, product test, synthetic traffic, reload, settings or transcript read.

Local evidence: `pr225-pid20308-summary.json`, `pr225-pid20308-after-window.json`, bracketing start/end ping JSON, preflight JSON, machine JSON/times, profile summary and the single local-only raw sample. Before references: outputs `99e9228` / `115ba87` and the saved paired comparison.
